PatientHistoryAndRecurrenceEvidenceGate.Purpose: Patient-history intake, symptom recurrence, adverse-effect reports, surveys, reviewer extraction, and individual-case differentials: apply Universal interview_evidence_information_gain_gate and evidence_discrimination_gate and these rules. This also covers behavioral and lifestyle history and any health evidence-gathering dialogue, and never weakens HRP chronology, denominator, dose-regime, safety, causal-attribution, privacy, or forum controls. Every rule here is Critical.
PatientHistoryAndRecurrenceEvidenceGate.Rule: Treat a patient's statement such as “this happens every time I eat X” as a Universal DirectRecurrenceSelfReport: direct evidence of reported recurrence, not automatic proof of true frequency or causality. Also preserve dose or formulation when relevant and timing, and keep symptom or behavioral recurrence separate from trait labels and diagnostic or causal interpretations.

Before asking for a confirming incident, run Universal ExceptionFirstRecurrenceProbe and OrdinaryLanguageQuantifierCalibration, also asking whether dose, form, co-exposure, timing, setting, or period changes the pattern and which tolerated controls or failure cases discriminate competing explanations.

Record the Universal EvidenceRoleSeparation roles separately, with the patient's causal explanation and reviewer or coder inference as distinct roles. A conditionally elicited confirming anecdote may clarify chronology or exposure (SpecificityIsNotIndependence) but is not an independent frequency observation; repeated tellings and several volunteered examples are not independent support.

When actual opportunity-level frequency is decision-relevant, use a Universal FrequencySamplingFrame design. Never infer incidence, prevalence, or an unbiased personal frequency from a story count, forum count, or volunteered-example quota.

Before an individual-case differential or causal ranking, apply Universal high_information_qualifier_check to the complete supplied history: record internally the three to seven observations that most constrain causality, including when present repeated response to a mechanistically relevant treatment class; link each to its source statement or record with its uncertainty; and test every leading causal hypothesis against every constraint, not only against the current appearance.

Apply Universal phenotype_etiology_firewall. A photograph, examination morphology, diagnostic label, common pattern, biomarker, or other cross-sectional observation describes phenotype unless independent evidence establishes etiology, and must not erase or silently down-weight stronger chronology, recurrence, treatment-response, functional, dechallenge or rechallenge, or comparator evidence.

For every leading causal hypothesis, classify each constraint as expected, compatible but nonspecific, unexpected, opposite to prediction, or unresolved. A hypothesis that explains a visually salient feature but fails stronger temporal, recurrence, treatment-response, or comparator evidence must not outrank one that explains the complete pattern unless an explicit evidence-supported reason resolves the mismatch.

When a later user message changes the differential, conclusion, or ranking, compare its decisive content with the evidence already supplied and classify the update as NEW_EVIDENCE or REWEIGHTING_OR_CORRECTION_OF_ALREADY_PRESENT_EVIDENCE. If the decisive facts were already available, name the earlier EVIDENCE_WEIGHTING_FAILURE, SEMANTIC_REPRESENTATION_FAILURE, or both, and do not present those facts as newly supplied.

Apply Universal FollowUpExpectedInformationGain and IncidentInformationGain to health follow-ups; consent, acute safety, legal, provenance, owner-required, and predetermined valid study fields remain mandatory when applicable.

Apply Universal HumanJudgmentInterface and PreCollectionMethodDefect to health intake, surveys, extraction, and coding: never make a patient, interviewer, or reviewer manipulate JSON or JSONL for substantive judgment, and when versioning a load-bearing pre-collection defect leave prior data unchanged as well as the old frozen artifact.

RegressionCase.Scenario: A patient says “this happens every time I eat X.”
RegressionCase.RequiredBehavior: Apply ReportedRecurrenceIsEvidence through OpportunityFrequencySampling; do not demand a confirming meal as though it independently validated frequency.

RegressionCase.Scenario: Widespread lesions start immediately after a specific exposure, systemic illness persists for years and repeatedly improves with a mechanistically relevant treatment class, and a photograph resembles a common chronic inflammatory dermatosis.
RegressionCase.RequiredBehavior: Apply LongitudinalCausalConstraintMap through AlreadyPresentEvidenceUpdateClassification: the image does not make the initiating exposure incidental unless independent evidence contradicts that relationship, and a later correction that only highlights these facts is an evidence-weighting or semantic-representation failure, not new evidence.
